Newton’s second law of motion states that:

  1. The net force acting on a body is equal to the product of its mass and velocity.
  2. When one body exerts a force on a second body, the second body simultaneously exerts a force equal in magnitude and opposite in direction on the first body.
  3. The net force acting on a body is proportional to the momentum of the body.
  4. The rate of change of momentum of a body is equal to the net force acting on the body.
